description: Baseline + pure shared building blocks for Issue #21. Confirm the repo baseline is green, then add the pure, unit-tested functions that the backend and frontend will reuse: (a) shared team brand colors available to the backend, (b) a localized share disclaimer constant (EN/JA: predictions are reference values, not betting advice), (c) a per-series OGP SVG markup builder (series + colors + score + win probability + disclaimer -> deterministic SVG string), (d) a crawler meta-tag HTML builder (series -> minimal HTML with OpenGraph/Twitter tags incl. og:image, og:description with the disclaimer, og:url, plus a redirect into the SPA route), and (e) a permalink/share-URL builder (season + seriesId + lang -> absolute URL with ?lang=). Keeping this logic pure in @mlb/shared means both the Lambda and the SPA import one tested source of truth. No AWS, no network.
steps: Confirm baseline: run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build && npm test && npm run synth` at repo root and confirm all pass before changing anything. Record any pre-existing failures.

Add shared team brand colors so the backend OG builder does not depend on frontend-only code. Create shared/src/teamColors.ts exporting `TeamColor { primary; secondary }`, a `DEFAULT_TEAM_COLOR`, the TEAM_COLORS map (copy the values from frontend/src/teamColors.ts), and `teamColor(teamId): TeamColor`. Re-export from shared/src/index.ts. Then refactor frontend/src/teamColors.ts to re-export from '@mlb/shared' (keep the existing `teamColor` named export and `TeamColor` type stable so no frontend consumer breaks). Add shared/src/teamColors.test.ts asserting known teams and the default fallback.

Add the localized share disclaimer in @mlb/shared. Create shared/src/share.ts. Export `SHARE_DISCLAIMER: Record<'en'|'ja', string>` with EN `Predictions are reference values, not betting advice.` and JA `予測は参考値であり、賭けの助言ではありません。`. Export a `ShareLang = 'en' | 'ja'` type (reuse the NarrativeLanguage/Lang convention). This string MUST be reused by the OG SVG builder, the meta-HTML builder, and surfaced to the frontend share text (criterion 3).

Add the pure OGP SVG builder in shared/src/ogImage.ts: `buildOgImageSvg(input: { series: Series; season: number; lang: ShareLang }): string`. Produce a deterministic 1200x630 SVG string that includes: a split background using each team's brand `primary` color (teamColor from shared), each team's display name (TEAMS[id].name, placeholder for unknown ids), the current series score (high.wins-low.wins) and round/season label, the model win probability + favorite computed by the shared pure `predict(series, bracket?)` (build a minimal single-series bracket wrapper; favorite team name + percentage), and the localized SHARE_DISCLAIMER text as a footer line. Escape all interpolated text for XML (`&`,`<`,`>`,`"`,`'`). Keep it a single pure function with no I/O. Add shared/src/ogImage.test.ts asserting: SVG root + viewBox 0 0 1200 630, both team names present, the score string present, the win-probability percentage present, and the exact localized disclaimer substring present for both en and ja, plus XML-escaping of a crafted team name.

Add the pure crawler meta-tag HTML builder in shared/src/shareHtml.ts: `buildShareHtml(input: { series: Series; season: number; lang: ShareLang; appUrl: string; ogImageUrl: string; canonicalUrl: string }): string`. Return a complete minimal HTML5 document (lang attribute from `lang`) whose <head> carries: <title>, meta description (localized summary incl. matchup + score), og:type=website, og:title, og:description (MUST include SHARE_DISCLAIMER text, criterion 3), og:image (= ogImageUrl), og:url (= canonicalUrl), twitter:card=summary_large_image, twitter:title, twitter:description, twitter:image. The <body> contains a human-visible summary + a link to `appUrl` AND BOTH a <meta http-equiv=refresh content="0;url=..."> and an inline <script>location.replace(appUrl)</script> so a human visitor is redirected into the SPA while a crawler reads the static meta tags (criterion 2). HTML-escape all interpolated values; the appUrl/canonical/ogImage are placed in attributes that are URL-encoded. Add shared/src/shareHtml.test.ts asserting each required meta tag/property is present with the right content, that og:description and the body both contain the localized disclaimer, that og:image equals ogImageUrl, that og:url equals canonicalUrl, and that both the meta-refresh and the location.replace to appUrl are emitted.

Add the pure permalink/share-URL builder in shared/src/permalink.ts: `buildSeriesPermalink(input: { origin: string; season: number; seriesId: string; lang?: ShareLang }): string` returning `${origin}/season/${season}/series/${encodeURIComponent(seriesId)}?lang=${lang}` (omit the lang query only when lang is undefined), and `buildShareUrl(...)` returning the `/share/...` crawler URL variant, and `buildOgImageUrl({ apiBase, season, seriesId, lang })` returning the `/og?...` image URL. Normalize/trim a trailing slash on origin/apiBase. Add shared/src/permalink.test.ts covering: lang present vs omitted, seriesId encoding, trailing-slash normalization, and the exact query string order (season path segment + ?lang=).
Export the new modules (share, ogImage, shareHtml, permalink, teamColors) from shared/src/index.ts.

Run `PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run build -w @mlb/shared && npm test -w @mlb/shared` and confirm green; then full `npm run build && npm test` to confirm the frontend teamColors re-export did not regress.
Commit with a conventional message, e.g. `feat(issue-21): shared OG-image SVG, share-HTML, permalink, team colors, and disclaimer builders`.
acceptance_criteria: shared/src/{teamColors,share,ogImage,shareHtml,permalink}.ts exist and are exported from shared/src/index.ts.

buildOgImageSvg returns a 1200x630 SVG containing both team names, the series score, the win-probability percentage, and the localized disclaimer for both en and ja; interpolated text is XML-escaped (covered by ogImage.test.ts).

buildShareHtml returns HTML with og:title/og:description(incl. disclaimer)/og:image/og:url/twitter:* tags and both a meta-refresh and a location.replace redirect to the SPA (covered by shareHtml.test.ts).
buildSeriesPermalink/buildShareUrl/buildOgImageUrl produce correct absolute URLs with ?lang= handling and seriesId encoding (covered by permalink.test.ts).
frontend/src/teamColors.ts re-exports the shared colors so no frontend consumer breaks.
`npm run build`, `npm test`, and `npm run synth` all pass.
findings: Baseline build/test/synth all green before changes (62 shared, 132 backend, 194 frontend, 10 infra tests; only pre-existing non-fatal CDK nodejs20.x runtime-deprecation WARNINGs during synth/stack test). Added pure shared modules: teamColors.ts (TeamColor, DEFAULT_TEAM_COLOR, TEAM_COLORS copied verbatim from frontend, teamColor()), share.ts (ShareLang + SHARE_DISCLAIMER en/ja), ogImage.ts (buildOgImageSvg + escapeXml), shareHtml.ts (buildShareHtml + escapeHtml), permalink.ts (buildSeriesPermalink/buildShareUrl/buildOgImageUrl). All exported from shared/src/index.ts. Refactored frontend/src/teamColors.ts to a thin re-export from '@mlb/shared' keeping named export teamColor and type TeamColor stable; frontend tests still green. Favorite/probability derived from shared pure predict() via a minimal single-series Bracket wrapper { season, updatedAt:'', series:[series] }. Added colocated tests teamColors/permalink/ogImage/shareHtml. Repo path is /projects/sandbox/kiro-mlb-postseason (not nested). Full build+test+synth green after changes.
